review_description: Batteries installed and working good for now for a month. Few hick ups during installation but Voltx team got it all sorted in time and clarified my questions. Install was tidy and punctual. Thanks team

The entire team from quote to installation was fabulous - so caring and professional. It was very refreshing to feel their commitment to ensuring I was totally satisfied not just mostly satisfied. They could teach a lesson about this to so many iconic consumer brands across Australia - congrats, well done and thank you team.  I bragged about my experience with you to 2 other folks on the weekend ;-).

Overall very happy with performance of the VoltX (NeoVolt Battery) energy. After initial hiccups in terms of quoting where the sales consultant deliberately didn't inform me about the hidden wiring fee (came to additinal $500 in the end) listed in the contract, rest of the process has been smooth. Happy I went with at least 30 KW battery , even though I have a smaller home. This allows me to particpate in VPP and export energy at decent prices plus never worry about unexpected demands from my house and EV. The app is pretty simple to understand and set up. Please be aware customer service is not easy to reach out to after the install. I only tried reaching out to clarify wiring fee, but it took me ages to reach out to someone.

I already had a 10kWh Neovolt battery (and Enphase 10kW solar PV system) working really well for over a year, so with the government rebate program I decided to investigate adding more storage capacity.  VoltX sales responded to my query, paid good attention to my needs, and gave me various options to optimise my decision.  I decided to add 3 extra batteries taking the total storage system to 40kWh, while opting to stay with the original 5kW inverter.The company explained up front that there was a surge in demand due to the rebate scheme and it could take up to 3 months.  I agreed and paid the deposit. After about 6 weeks they contacted me and scheduled an appointment for installation. The installers arrived on time and did a very neat job.There was a problem initially after the extra batteries were installed - the system would not charge above 88%.  With help from VoltX Technical Support a firmware update was installed remotely and the system immediately worked properly.My 40kWh system is fully charged most days by midday. It allows me to cook, use aircon and any appliances at night without grid imports.  I've made it through consecutive days of heavy cloud and continuous rain without getting close to fully draining the battery system.The monitoring App is accurate and easy to understand.  Wireless connectivity is good.I'm a happy customer and very pleased with all aspects of their service.

The quality of the batteries that they installed appear to be good.That is about the only good thing about this 0 star business. Unfortunately, 0 stars is not an option.From the start, they managed to repeatedly misplace my energy bill and photographs that I submitted to them. I had to resend it to them a few times. They did not come to my place or talk to me about my blackout protection requirements, so it does not meet all my needs. My home office does not have blackout protection.To make matters worse, they rushed the install. The brought it forward from December to November, and did not tell me that I could have gotten a much better offer had I changed to use the new rebates and new products. The system that I have right now is very poor value for money compared to the system that I could have gotten by cancelling my original order scheduled for December and ordered something from a higher quality company or even gotten a new offer from VoltX.I know that they could have offered me a better deal because I had asked them about a different modular battery and they were very happy to make that offer to me. They were very happy to let me change my order when it made them more money.The installation itself went badly. The smart meter was not installed correctly. It was reading as high as 8kW to 9kW as the load from my home. It also tried to charge the battery from almost 0% (It was a very dark rainy day) to 100% overnight by drawing power from the grid. It might have tried to overcharge the battery. The electrician had to return twice to make it work correctly.I did not think much about it, but the installer left a number of plastic bags, leftover material (ie. wire cuttings, screws, ...) and cigarette butts. I suspect that one of the electricians was very stressed by his failed attempts to attach the smart meter to the 3 phase power. I counted at least 6 or 7 used cigarette butts around my fuse box and 2 in my neighbour's front yard.Currently, there is a defective LED light on one of the brand new batteries. The electrician said that he would report it to VoltX Energy.I have exchanged several emails with VoltX Energy and they are still refusing to actually do something about that defective LED light.If one defective LED light can be so hard to get people to acknowledge, I hate to think what kind of nightmares VoltX will put up if the battery develops a major fault while under warranty.They have been given at least 2 chances to make it up to me after I commented on their Facebook page. They have been good at making empty promises but have not actually delivered or done anything.
Great value.Incredibly neat installation.Easy control of batteries.Customer service were great to deal with.

The sales process was very quick and efficient. There was obviously a delay with the supply of the batteries due to huge demand but the install team contacted me and organized install in a timely fashion once the batteries were available. The installers were great to work with and were able to accommodate my requests installation.This is my second time buying with Voltx and I've enjoyed both experiences.I've recommended Voltx to a few people now and will continue to recommend them.

Had a battery system installed (30kw system being advertised). It worked fine for the first 6.5 days, before it stopped discharging and went into protection mode. Have emailed customer support (5 days no response, tried ringing voltx and no answer, texting the agent who helped organise the install with no answer. The problem may be a simple fix that could be explained over the phone, but will never know if no one makes contact. This companies customer support is non existent. They are claiming a 10 year warranty and the system hasn't even worked 10 days. What good even is a warranty if there is zero technical support to even make a claim.Learn from my mistake and avoid at all cost. If you have already made a deposit on a system ask for a refund and run.

I installed 5Kw of panel 5 years ago, so costs etc relate only to my recent battery installation. I had considered a battery before the federal rebate and found it uneconomical. I explored a battery again after the rebate was announced, but the conclusion was the same until I came across Voltx.LG, a big name respected battery provider, had a major recall, so I figured it can happen to any of them and who knows how any of the batteries will perform, or how long they will last, so I went with Voltx at just over half the price of the big names. The installation went smoothly and was very tidy. I may regret it, but then again, I may not.
